items.text: “Gambira ekitebe ekya Isirairi ngu: Mube bantu abarukwera, habwokuba, nyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu ninyera.
Buli omu omuli inywe, atemuga ekitiinisa ise na nyina, kandi mutemuga ekitiinisa ekiro kyange ekya Sabbato; Ninyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu.
Mutaliramya ebintu ebitaina mugaso noobwakwakuba kwagya ebyoma mukekorramu baaruhanga. Ninyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu.
“Obu muraabaga nimuha MUKAMA ekyonzira habw'okusaba Obusinge mukihege nukwo musiimwe.
Kiriibwege ha kiro kyonyini eki muraabaga mukiheeriireyo rundi nyenkya bukiire; ekintu kyona ekiraabaga kisigaireho okuhika ha kiro ekya kasatu, bakyokyeege kisiiriire.
Kakuba kiriibwa ha kiro ekya kasatu, kiba ky'omuziro kandi tikirisiimwa,
Omuntu wena anyakukiryaho, ayeretera omusango, habwokuba asiisire ekintu ekirukwera ekya MUKAMA; omuntu ogu araihwaga omu bantu b'owaabu.
“Obu oraabaga noogesa oleke kuhikira kimu ha nsaaro y'omusiri rundi kugesa okamarraamu kimu.
Emiti yawe ey'orugonjo orw'emizabbibbu, otaliginogaho ebijuma okabimaraho, noobu kwakuba kusorooza ebigwire hansi, ebi byona obirekere abanaku n'abanyamahanga; ninyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu.
Mutalirahirra busa ibara lyange, mukajumisa ibara lya Ruhanga wanyu: Ninyowe MUKAMA.
“Otalibonesa omutaahi rundi kumunyaga. Otalikeerereza omusaara gw'omuntu ou oragaine na uwe kukukorra omulimo okakiisa obwire.
Otalikondereza omufu w'amatu rundi kuta ekintu omu muhanda omufu w'amaiso eki arukwija kuhuumira, kyonka otiinege Ruhanga wawe; Ninyowe MUKAMA.
“Otalicwa omusango ogw'okuhendeerra; otaligogeereza omunaku rundi kutiina omuntu ow'ekitiinisa, baitu omutaahi omucwere nookuraatira obulyo.
Tosemeriire kugendagenda noogeya abantu rundi kunaga omuntu mutaahi wawe omu kabi: Ninyowe MUKAMA.
“Mugenzi wawe otalimwitira ha mutima, ohanuulege n'omutaahi, taikara kukunaga omu kibi.
Otalyehorra enzigu rundi kugirra itima abaana b'abantu b'owanyu, baitu ogonzeege mutaahi wawe nkooku oyegonza wenka Ninyowe MUKAMA.

“Okwatege ebiragiro byange. Ente zawe zitalyemebwa ez'oruganda orundi; omusiri gwawe otaligubyaramu embibo z'enganda ibiri kandi otalikisura okajwara ekikozirwe omu huuzo ezinyakurangirwe omu bintu eby'emiringo ebiri.

“Kakuba omusaija abyama n'omukazi omuzaana anyakujumbiirwe omusaija ondi, kyonka omuzaana ogu atakacungwirwe rundi atakalekiirwe, ebigambo byabo biraayetegerezibwaga. Tibaitwege, habwokuba omuzaana abaire atakalekiirwe;
kyonka omusaija aleeterege MUKAMA ekihongwa eky'okumuganyiza omusango, akireete ha mulyango ogw'Eheema ey'okutangatanganiramu, ekihongwa eki, ebege mpaya y'entaama.
Nyakatagara amutonganirrege hali MUKAMA naahonga ekihongwa eki, habw'ekibi eki yakozire; Nukwo MUKAMA amuganyire eki yakozire.
“Obu mulihika omunsi, mubyaire emiti ey'emiringo yoona ey'erukuliibwa ebijuma, ebijuma byayo mutalibirya okumara emyaka esatu, omu kasumi ako muliba nimubitangwa.
Omu mwaka ogwa kana, biraabaga biri ebirukwera, kihongwa eky'okusiima MUKAMA.
Baitu omu mwaka ogwa kataano, mulye ebijuma byayo, nukwo emiti eyongere kubaanira ebingi: Ninyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu.
“Mutalirya enyama yoona ekyarumu esagama. Mutaliraguza kandi mutalibandwa.
Mutalyemwa mukasiga ekisunsu kandi mutalimwa ebitarra eby'emireju yanyu.
Mutalyesara ensaro ha mibiri yanyu habw'abantu abaafiire kandi mutalyesara engondo habw'emigenzo. Ninyowe MUKAMA.
“Otaliikiriza muhara wawe kufooka malaaya, ensi etaliikara kwijura obwamalaaya, ekasiisikara.
Otemuga ekitiinisa ekiro kyange ekya Sabbato n'ekiikaro kyange ekirukwera: Ninyowe MUKAMA.
“Otaliteerana n'abafumu n'abarogo; otalibeeha bakakusiisa: Ninyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu.
“Oimukirege abakuru omu myaka, otemuga ekitiinisa abagurusi n'abakaikuru kandi otiinege Ruhanga wawe: Ninyowe MUKAMA.
“Omunyaihanga kakuba akwebinga omunsi y'owanyu, otalimukora kubi.

Omunyaihanga wena arukwikara na inywe mumusisanizeege nk'enzaarwa aboikara nabo, omugonzeege nkooku oyegonza wenka; habwokuba na inywe omunsi Misiri, mukaba muli banyamahanga: Ninyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu.
“Mube beesigwa omu bintu binu: Omu kulenga obura bw'ebintu, omu kulemeera kwabyo rundi obwingi bwabyo.
Mube na minzaani ezinyakuhikire, amabaale aganyakuhikire, endengo enyakuhikire: Ninyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu ayabaihire omunsi Misiri.
Mukwate ebiragiro byange byona, n'ebigambo byange kandi mukole eki birukuragira: Ninyowe MUKAMA.”
